title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the role
Data science is in a moment of reinvention: AI-generated code and agentic workflows are changing what it means to put analytical work into production. Posit’s mission is to empower people to conduct trustworthy data analysis for themselves, their organizations, and the world at large. Posit Team is the trusted on-premises platform at the center: a place where data scientists and the organizations that rely on them can explore data, deploy applications and agents, expose and consume MCP servers, and do all of it with the visibility, accountability, and reproducibility that serious analytical work demands.
We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bring a builder’s instinct to a team working at the intersection of data science, infrastructure, and AI. You will help us build new capabilities and features in our product suite, including things we haven’t yet imagined possible, and you will drive those changes forward into our customers’ hands.
About you
You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements-an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most:
High agency
You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers.
Boldness in learning
You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. You're not afraid to ask questions and make mistakes, because learning new techniques feels like an adventure and we share what we learn as a team. Proficiency in either Go or Typescript as well as in either Python or R, and experience with backend systems, data tooling, and data science frameworks are helpful for this role. Eagerness and boldness to learn is essential.
User empathy and product sense
You make judgment calls on behalf of users with minimal up front guidance and are willing to be wrong, because you will learn. Prior domain expertise with data science as a practice may help, but it is not the only way. Regardless, you lead with empathy: you optimize for solving a real customer problem, not for technical purity.
Collaborative curiosity
You are generous. When you learn something useful, your first instinct is to share it. You teach as readily as you learn, ask questions without ego, admit what you don't know, and lend a hand when someone's stuck.
Interest in AI
You are interested not just in using AI in your work, but building tools for customers to use AI in their own work. You also are curious, and you question when AI is not the right answer for a particular problem. You lean on your user empathy when building: knowing that some of our customers use and love AI in data science and others don’t or are restricted from using it.
Results-driven
You are focused on delivering measurable value to customers. You have a strong technical background with a track record of shipping successful products.
Within one week, you will…

• Ship code changes that meaningfully improves the experience for our customers.
Within one month, you will…

• See your changes reflected in our public releases.

• Participate in feature planning and provide feedback.

• Feel comfortable navigating the codebase and understand how things fit together.

Within three months, you will…

• Plan features and drive their development.

• Have a track record of teaching team members; both from your expertise and things you learn as you build.

• Have a track record of learning: both from the things you learned and taught us along the way; and from listening to internal users, external users, and how our customers use our products.

Within six months, you will…

• Point to new features you built that we hadn’t even dreamed were possible.

You’ll join a lean, world-class Product Team. We’ve thought deeply about what winning product culture looks like in competitive markets being reshaped by AI. • Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs

• Expanding audience targeting & syncing to better support advanced use cases like couponing and live auctions

This role is fully remote but your work schedule needs to overlap comfortably with a European work day. We're an async-first culture that values deep focused work, but we still make time to get together in person at regular team off-sites.

- Partner directly with our founding designer, product and engineering teams to take projects on our roadmap from rough problem to shipped solution.

- Look for opportunities to improve our existing product areas. Sometimes that's a full rethink of how something works, others itʼs fixing smaller quality issues you pick up in the product.

- Help define and improve our evolving design system.

- Bring our brand to life across marketing, social and launch content.

- Design mockups and prototypes in low and high fidelity to communicate ideas and how things might work.

- Be part of and contribute to a growing design culture that's still taking shape.

- Sweat the details that make embedded UI feel trustworthy.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Solid and proven software design experience

- Youʼve ideally designed software for SaaS businesses, but we also love to see range in the type of products youʼve worked on.

- Breadth of craft: Youʼre able to comfortably flex across visual design, product thinking, brand, and interaction design.

- Systems thinking: you can design components and patterns while thinking about how they fit into the broader system, but you also know when to push past convention and innovate.

- Courage to challenge ideas, try new things and push a product direction forward.

- Fluency designing in Figma and other prototyping tools. You also experiment regularly with new tooling.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills. We have an async work culture.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment, where the stakes are high and priorities can shift quickly. Bonus points if you have both in-house (especially at a startup) and agency experience.

WHAT WE OFFER:

- Remote-first, Europe-based (but must be within CET +/-3 hours)

- Competitive salary + eVSOPS

- Backed by leading VCs like HV Capital, byFounders, Notion Capital

title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
description:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
Why South Africa
South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.
So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in South Africa.
About The Role
Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint , and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.
Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform - and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.
The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there - the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.
This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering - not a purely backend platform leader.
Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.
You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one - engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

• Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.

• Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.

• Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.

We are looking for an engineering leader to work on Customer Studio, Hightouch ’s second major product that provides a purpose-built no-code suite of features that enables anyone, regardless of their SQL experience, to activate data directly from their warehouse. The product has grown extremely quickly, now accounting for half of our revenue, and we’re continuing to invest aggressively in this area. There are still a ton of exciting projects and challenges ahead, which also gives this role the potential to have significant impact.
At Hightouch , our engineering leaders serve as both active technical voices and strong people managers. The key outcomes we are looking for from this role include:

•
Product Development: Lead the team in roadmapping and executing successful development of significant features and products as required to drive the business forward. Uphold a high technical bar, while making pragmatic tradeoffs

•
Pace: Through a combination of leadership and technical expertise, improve the pace of execution of the team

•
Recruiting: Be responsible for growing the team, including identifying needs, deciding how to evaluate candidates, and ensuring we hire high impact team members

•
Reliability: Against the uphill battle of high growth/scale, up-level the team on reliability, resulting in fewer incidents, catching our own issues before our customers do, and a strong incident management hygiene

•
People: Foster growth of team members and ensure strong engagement and motivation

Some of the problems we’ll be working on include:

•
Data Warehouse Performance: We’re consistently pushing the limits of what data warehouses can handle in terms of speed, performance, and interactivity. We explore optimizations generally (e.g. optimizing queries, storing pre-computed state), as well as investigate warehouse-specific improvements.

•
Analytics and Experimentation: How can Hightouch help customers build segments and decide what data they want to sync? How can we facilitate experimentation to downstream tools, including tracking the performance of different audiences?

•
Real-time Audience Syncing: Our users are always interested in faster syncing and fresher data. As warehouses become more real-time and adopt technologies like CDC, we’re excited to explore real-time audience computation and syncing.

•
Generative AI: We’re continuously working on making the user experience of acting on data more seamless, and are optimistic generative AI can enhance user workflows.

What We Offer
We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $220,000 - $400,000 USD per year,

Join Pure Storage’s Global Partner Marketing Organization (GPMO) to redefine how we co-market with our most strategic technology alliance partners. • Collaborative Influence: Strong communication skills and executive presence, with a track record of building cross-functional buy-in and influencing senior-level stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

$126,000 — $273,000 USD

• Strong project management skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple programs and stakeholders simultaneously.

title: Head of UK Customer Delivery
description:
Head of UK Customer Delivery
About Lyrebird

Lyrebird Health is building a category defining healthcare platform used daily by thousands of clinicians across the UK.
Today, it is the most widely deployed clinical ambient AI platform in the NHS, scaling nationally on the strength of exceptional real world delivery and reference-led growth.
Clinicians rely on the product in environments where errors are costly and time is scarce. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load and delivering durable impact at scale.
Commercial traction is accelerating across the NHS. Exceptional implementation is not a downstream support function. It is our primary growth engine.
The Role
This role owns customer delivery across the entire UK.
You will build, lead and scale the UK delivery engine from the ground up, defining the national delivery standards and operating model that regional leads execute against.
Every trust must have an exceptional experience. Every rollout should be reference worthy, and every clinician interaction must reinforce trust in the product.
This is a foundational leadership role with executive backing to enforce standards and build the function properly. You will franchise our delivery model into the UK, establish the systems that define excellence, and create a delivery engine capable of scaling across a national health system. The engine you build must strengthen with scale, delivering an increasingly exceptional experience as we expand to 50, 100 and ultimately every NHS trust.
What you'll do

• Own every UK implementation end to end, from signature to scaled adoption

• Design and operationalise the UK delivery model

• Define governance, reporting frameworks and escalation structures

• Build and lead a high performance implementation function

• Establish customer engagement standards across demos, training, go live and support

• Ensure every rollout is structured, measurable and reference worthy

• Operationalise high fidelity adoption visibility across trusts, departments and clinicians

• Partner closely with Commercial to ensure pilots convert into long term wins

What you'll bring

• Significant experience leading large scale NHS deployments supplier side

• Experience running 10+ concurrent trust rollouts

• Proven record of building greenfield delivery functions into scalable operations

• Deep quantitative orientation with the ability to build early warning systems and adoption dashboards

• Strong understanding of NHS politics, procurement and stakeholder dynamics

• History of successful deployments recognised as reference accounts

• Direct, precise communication style

• High ownership mindset and operational discipline

Why This Role Matters
In the NHS, the best pipeline builder is a well run implementation.
Exceptional delivery creates reference accounts, and reference accounts drive sustained momentum across the NHS. This role defines that engine for the UK.
The standard set here will shape how Lyrebird scales nationally and influence what NHS trusts expect from us as a partner.
For the right leader, this is an opportunity to define how a category defining healthcare company scales across a national health system.
At Lyrebird, we don’t just write code - we help shape the future of the human experience.
If you want to pioneer, to create, and to see your work touch lives directly, we’d love to hear from you.
We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who’ll benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we especially encourage you to apply - even if you don’t meet every single requirement.

• Hands-on experience with model quantization (PTQ, QAT, INT8/INT4/MX4), low-precision numerics, or hardware-aware model optimization

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Learn more about us here!

About your new role:

CommandLink is looking for a Cost Optimization Analyst to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, loves Excel, and wants to help improve processes that drive savings and efficiency across the business.

You’ll start by learning how to audit, analyze, and organize cost data. As you grow, you’ll take on projects that let you shape processes, collaborate with teams, and make a direct impact on how we optimize costs.

• Assist in managing projects by organizing tasks, keeping things on track, and meeting deadlines.

• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, lookups, and data analysis).

• Interest in process improvement and project management; prior exposure is a plus, but a willingness to learn is even more important.

title: SEO & Content Manager
description:
About Compound Growth Marketing (CGM)
Compound Growth Marketing (CGM) is a marketing consultancy built to help ambitious B2B SaaS and technology companies scale to $100M+ in revenue by building sustainable, repeatable demand generation systems.
We help clients grow by designing and optimizing a Predictable Demand System™, focused on three compounding drivers of growth:

• Deal Volume

• Deal Process

• Actionable Insights

Our work spans go-to-market strategy, paid acquisition, demand capture (SEO & AI-optimized content), funnel automation, and advanced analytics. We partner closely with our clients' revenue, marketing, and operations teams to drive measurable outcomes - not just activity.
Client demand for organic and AI-search visibility (AEO/GEO) is accelerating faster than almost any other channel we run. We're building out the SEO practice to meet that demand with a standardized, scalable delivery model, and we're hiring a Manager to help lead it.
About the Role
The SEO & Content Manager owns SEO and AI-search-visibility (AEO/GEO) strategy for a portfolio of 6-12 B2B client accounts, and owns the output of the analysts who execute against that strategy.
You report to the Head of SEO and work alongside peer Managers within the practice. This is a working-manager role: you lead the work directly - strategy, planning, quality bar - and, as the practice grows, lead a small team of analysts who execute against your plan. We're talking hands-on ownership of both the strategy and the people delivering it, with people-management advancement pathing that grows over time.
This is an ideal role for someone who:

• Is genuinely excited about where SEO is headed as LLMs reshape search, and already treats AI visibility as essential SEO work rather than an emerging trend

• Sees SEO in B2B as equal parts technical execution and content strategy, and doesn't need convincing that the technical fundamentals matter just as much as knowing what content will actually earn visibility with the target buyer

• Gets personal joy from leading others and helping them grow, with a desire to do the hard work of building a team over time

• Comfortable operating as the subject-matter expert behind the scenes, briefing the Account Manager so they can speak to strategy and results with confidence

What You Do
Strategy & Planning

• Own SEO and AEO strategy for your portfolio, translating performance data into a prioritized plan for analysts to execute, and adjusting when things change

• Maintain a forward view of each account's work three to six months out, not just the current sprint

• Partner with Project Managers to scope planned work against client budgets and team capacity

• Own content strategy for your portfolio: direct topics, structure, and optimization guidance for analysts to execute

Team Leadership & Ownership of Output

• Own the output of your analyst team: every audit, brief, technical recommendation, or report that reaches a client reflects your standard and your accountability

• Coach and develop your analysts, building their skill and judgment so they need less direct oversight over time

• Take a role in hiring, performance reviews, and promotion or termination decisions for your team, in partnership with the Head of SEO

AI Search Visibility (AEO/GEO)

• Own AI-search-visibility strategy for your portfolio - monitoring how clients show up across ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, and comparable surfaces

• Help define how CGM benchmarks and measures AEO performance for clients, including which tools and metrics actually indicate progress in a space that hasn't standardized on either yet

• Bring hard evidence to AEO recommendations - what changed, what moved, and why

• Track how AI search surfaces are evolving and translate that into concrete guidance for clients and analysts

Performance & Client Communication

• Monitor performance across your portfolio and translate results into next-step recommendations

• Work hand-in-hand

title: Data Engineer
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

AlphaSense is building the function that governs AI across the enterprise: the product, engineering workflows, business processes, third-party services, and a fast-growing footprint of autonomous agents and MCP connectors. That function has one hard obligation it cannot delegate. When the board asks how much AI risk we carry, or an ISO 42001 auditor asks where a control-coverage number came from, there has to be a defensible answer with a traceable path back to a source system.

You will build the data layer that makes that answer possible.

This is an analytics engineering role, not a dashboard role. You will own the governance data model, the pipelines that populate it, the data quality and lineage that make it trustworthy, and the metrics and reporting built on top. The numbers you produce will go to the CISO, the AI Governance Council, external auditors, and the board. Some of them will be challenged. Your job is to make sure they hold up.

You will work alongside an AI Security Analyst and an AI Security Automation Engineer, reporting to the Director. You will also work with Enterprise Data and Analytics on platform, semantic definitions, and BI standards, and with Product Security, SecOps, Identity, Secure IT, and Procurement, whose systems supply most of your data.

Scope boundary, stated up front. The Automation Engineer owns integration to external source systems and delivers raw data into a defined landing zone. You own everything downstream of that boundary: the data model, transformation, quality, lineage, metrics, and reporting. You specify what you need and in what shape; you are not maintaining seven partner API integrations yourself.

What You'll Own

• Governance Data Model and Pipelines
Own the analytical data model for AI governance: AI systems and agents, owners, risk classifications, assessments, findings, exceptions, control results, incidents, vendors, and usage. Build and maintain the transformation layer that turns raw landed data into that model, with tests, version control, and CI.
The model has to answer questions nobody has asked yet, because the regulatory and board questions will keep changing. Design for that.

• Data Quality and Lineage
Own the trustworthiness of governance data. Build automated data quality checks, freshness and completeness monitoring, and end-to-end lineage that traces any reported figure back to its source system, extraction time, and transformation path.
Lineage is not a nice-to-have here. An auditor will ask, and evidence by default is one of the function's operating principles. A number we cannot trace is a number we cannot report.

• Registry Data Integrity and AIBOM Reconciliation

Freedom Challenge USA

Location: New York, NY (Hybrid) | Practice Area : Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Help Financial Services organizations turn advances in AI into practical, responsible transformation at enterprise scale.

As a Principal Consultant - AI Transformation & Adoption , you will help leading Financial Services organizations translate advances in AI into meaningful changes in how their businesses operate and how their people work.

Working directly with clients, you will lead AI transformation and adoption initiatives, helping organizations identify where AI can create value, redesign roles and workflows, build the capabilities required to sustain new ways of working, and measure the resulting business impact.

Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (** and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases.
In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.
What We Do
The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.
About the Role
This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.
Key Responsibilities

• Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.

• Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.

• Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.

• Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.

• Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started
Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise - on your own schedule.
Educational qualifications

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience
Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.
Technical Skills (Essential)

• Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.

• Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.

• Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.

• Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

• Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.

• Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.

• Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.

• English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

• Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

title: Partner Readiness Specialist-Singapore
description:
Partner Readiness Specialist
Extreme Networks  
Location: APAC (Flexible)  
Department: Channel Go-To-Market  
Reports To: Senior Director, Go-To-Market APAC
 
About Extreme Networks
 
Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions. They rely on our industry-leading products, services, and support to accelerate digital transformation and deliver measurable business outcomes. At Extreme Networks, we believe in teamwork, transparency, candor, curiosity, ownership, and inclusion as the foundation of our success.
 
Position Summary
 
The Partner Readiness Specialist serves as the bridge between Channel Sales, Systems Engineering, Marketing, Professional Services, Revenue Enablement, and Partner Organizations across Asia Pacific.
 
This role combines the skills of a Sales Engineer, Technical Trainer, Business Process Specialist, and Channel Consultant to build partner capability and accelerate partner-led growth. The successful candidate will enable partner sales teams, partner systems engineers, distributors, and strategic alliance partners to confidently position, demonstrate, design, sell, and support Extreme Networks solutions.
 
The role is focused on helping partners become self-sufficient, technically competent, and commercially successful while increasing the scale and impact of the Extreme partner ecosystem. This includes supporting certifications, sales methodologies, technical competency, business planning, onboarding, and adoption of Extreme programs and tools.

Why This Role Exists
 
Extreme Networks' growth strategy depends on building a highly capable ecosystem of partners that can independently position, sell, design, deploy, and support our solutions. The Partner Readiness Specialist accelerates that capability by bringing together technical expertise, sales acumen, business process knowledge, and partner engagement into a single field-facing role that drives partner success and scalable growth across APAC.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Basel

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Director, Clinical Development
description:
About Us
Join us in helping patients with rare diseases. At Egetis Therapeutics we challenge the status quo for the benefit of those in need. We offer an open, positive and supportive culture where everyone can be their best. Through trust, we work seamlessly across functions. As an employee you are empowered and encouraged to have an entrepreneurial spirit, enjoying an organization with conscious and efficient decision-making and we take pride in our collaborative working environment! In February 2025, the European Commission approved Egetis’ Emcitate® (tiratricol) as the first and only treatment of peripheral thyrotoxicosis in patients with monocarboxylate transporter 8 (MCT8) deficiency (Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome). In March 2026, the U.S. FDA accepted the filing of Egetis’ New Drug Application (NDA) for Emcitate® (tiratricol) for the treatment of MCT8 deficiency and granted Priority Review. The Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date is September 28, 2026.
As a courageous, committed, and collaborative organization, we are seeking to grow our team to drive success both in the pre-launch and post launch phases. For more information, please visit our website at www.egetis.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

Our Values
Courageous - Challenge the status quo for the benefit of the patient
Committed - Operate with high ethical standards through an efficient organization to deliver top quality results
Collaborative - Through trust, work seamlessly across functions and with external partners

Purpose of the role
The Director, Clinical Development provides the medical and scientific leadership required to oversee the design, conduct, and interpretation of assigned clinical study(ies) within the tiratricol programs and other Egetis development projects. Acting as the study physician, the role holder serves as the primary medical point of accountability for study-level clinical strategy, participant safety, data integrity, and scientific quality, working cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, and external investigators and vendors, under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Egetis headquarters is in Stockholm, Sweden, and we welcome applications from candidates based anywhere within the Central European timezone (CET/CEST) with no relocation required. Stockholm-based or near-by area applicants are equally welcome to work from our office. Duties and Responsibilities
Clinical strategy and study design

• Provide medical and scientific input into the study concept, target product profile, and clinical development plan for the assigned indication.

• Author or co-author the clinical sections of the study protocol, including objectives, endpoints, eligibility criteria, dosing rationale, and estimands; ensure scientific and ethical integrity of the design.

• Contribute to protocol synopses, amendments, and the design of the schedule of activities, ensuring feasibility and alignment with regulatory expectations.

• Provide clinical input into case report form (CRF) design, edit checks, and the data management and monitoring plans.

Medical oversight of study conduct

• Act as the study physician / medical monitor, providing day-to-day medical guidance to sites, Clinical Operations, and the CRO throughout study conduct.

• Review eligibility questions, protocol deviations, and dose-modification decisions; respond to investigator medical queries in a timely manner.

• Provide medical input into monitoring strategy, site selection, investigator engagement, and study start-up activities.

• Support recruitment and retention through medical education of sites and development of study-specific medical guidance and FAQs.

Participant safety and pharmacovigilance

• Serve as the medical reviewer for adverse events and serious adverse events at the study level; perform ongoing medical review of safety data in collaboration with Pharmacovigilance.

title: Network Designer
description:
About the Company
Charter is an award‑winning Canadian IT Solutions and Managed Services Provider founded in 1997. With offices across Canada, Charter delivers innovative IT solutions, managed services, project delivery, consulting, and staff augmentation expertise to organizations nationwide. Our mission is to align people, processes, and technologies to help clients enhance communication, optimize performance, and modernize their operations. Using business architecture methodology and human‑centered design, we guide clients through successful digital transformations, uncover new opportunities, and accelerate growth.
We are seeking a Network Designer, Facilities & Power to support the design and implementation of telecommunications facilities, including central offices, remote huts, cabinets, and points of presence (POPs). This role is responsible for developing construction-ready designs covering facility layouts, DC power systems, battery backup, standby generation, environmental systems, bills of material, and project cost estimates.
A key focus of the role is establishing and maintaining standardized facility and power designs, ensuring consistency, scalability, and operational efficiency across the network. Working closely with technical and operational teams, the successful candidate will support new site deployments, facility upgrades, procurement planning, and construction activities.
Key Responsibilities
Develop standardized facility, power, and equipment designs for telecom sites.
Produce inside plant layouts, rack elevations, power distribution, grounding, and cable management designs.
Design and size DC power, battery backup, standby generation, and environmental systems.
Prepare construction packages, technical drawings, specifications, and as-built documentation.
Develop bills of material, cost estimates, and procurement support documentation.
Review installation progress, respond to field inquiries, and support commissioning activities.
Collaborate with network, outside plant, project management, and operations teams to ensure successful project delivery.
Required Qualifications
Diploma or degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering Technology or equivalent experience.
Minimum 3 years of experience in telecommunications facilities, inside plant, central office, data centre, or related electrical infrastructure design.
Knowledge of -48V DC power systems, batteries, generators, and power distribution.
Ability to create and interpret single-line diagrams, equipment layouts, and construction drawings.
Proficiency with AutoCAD and Microsoft Excel.
Strong estimating, documentation, and organizational skills.
Ability to work independently and coordinate with remote teams and contractors.
Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel to project sites as required.
Working Conditions
Remote position with regular video collaboration with the team, field staff, and contractors
Occasional travel to sites, some by air or water, where conditions can include ladders, outdoor cabinets, restricted spaces, and adverse weather
Occasional after-hours or weekend work for maintenance windows, cutovers, and outages
Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and to access equipment at height and in restricted spaces
Benefits Summary
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees.
Pension Plan with employer and employee contributions, employer-paid extended health and dental coverage, health and lifestyle spending accounts, short-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment insurance, dependent life insurance, and access to an Employee Assistance Program.
Employees also have the option to purchase additional life insurance coverage for themselves, their spouse, and their children, as well as long-term disability coverage.
Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 CAD Originally posted on Himalayas

title: GRC Analyst

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

The ideal candidate is experienced in third-party risk management, has worked on RFPs, security questionnaires, is familiar with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and DORA, and is comfortable working cross-functionally with IT, Legal, Product, Security, and HR.

•
This is the moment. It’s an exciting time at Parallels , with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.

•
We want you to be you . Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.

•

• Assist in the development, review, and implementation of GRC policies and procedures. Help ensure policies stay current with regulatory changes and organizational needs, and support employee awareness of policy requirements.

• Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience)

• 4+ years of experience in GRC, IT audit, information security, or a related compliance role

• Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, and DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) requirements

• Experience with risk register tools, Trust Centers, GRC platforms and ticketing systems

• Excellent written communication skills for policy drafting and compliance reporting

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple concurrent reviews and deadlines
